f1.title: Drag & Drop Loading
f1.desc: Load audio files (WAV, AIFF, MP3) by dragging them in. Waveform shows up instantly.

f2.desc: Granular mode for textures. Control grain size, random playback, crossfade. Good for sound design.

f3.title: Custom Tremolo Effect
f3.desc: Manual DSP tremolo. LFO and amplitude modulation. Control rate and depth.

f4.title: Filter System
f4.desc: High/Low-pass filters with real-time control. 20Hz to 20kHz range.

f5.title: Built-in Compressor
f5.desc: Compressor with threshold, ratio, attack, release. Full automation.

f6.title: Advanced Looping
f6.desc: Set loop regions, adjust tempo (20-300 BPM). Good for rhythmic patterns and textures.

f7.title: Dual Waveform Display
f7.desc: Offline and real-time waveform visualization. Monitor your audio processing visually.

f8.title: Volume Safety System
f8.desc: Built-in peak protection with automatic detection. Prevents audio damage with smart volume monitoring and safety alerts.

f9.title: Full Automation
f9.desc: AudioProcessorValueTreeState for complete parameter automation. All controls can be automated in your DAW for dynamic performances.
